messages:
Mira: Heads-up: onboarding tenant 'helio-2' needs p4d+p5+g5 capacity in eu-west-12 and we also need NAT gateway IPs + BGP route approvals. They plan to start with 8 p5s and 4 p4ds.

Jon: Do we already have ENI headroom on their org/account? Last time I checked the per-account ENI limit was 250.

Samir: Account currently has 250 ENI. For the proposed fleet across 3 AZs we estimate ~600 ENIs steady-state, peak ~1100. We should request ENI limit -> 1500. Also will need Elastic IP quota bump (NATGW uses EIPs).

Mira: I'm going to open the AWS case with entitlements + ENI + EIP increases. Adding cost/justify and the launch timeline. Samir, can you paste the BGP/traffic notes we need to include?

Samir: Pasting the network notes we should include in the case:
```
Traffic profile: heavy egress during model warmup, sustained bursts up to 100Gbps cross-AZ.
NATGW: require scaling across AZs with sticky mapping for long-lived TCP connections.
Connections: expect up to 5k concurrent TCP connections per NATGW during peak.
BGP: tenant will advertise 10.50.0.0/16 via Direct Connect + TGW; request pre-authorization for prefixes and ASN.
IPv6: tenant wants dual-stack; request IPv6 prefix delegation (/56) and confirmation of ENI impact.
```

ops-sre: Also confirm whether we need a public AZ NAT per AZ or if we can centralize to two AZs for cost. Centralizing increases cross-AZ data charges and requires TGW routing.

Mira: Confirmed they prefer per-AZ NAT for predictable egress latency. Adding IPv6 request to the case as well.

infra-bot: Created AWS support case 012345678901 (AccountLimitIncrease). Region: eu-west-12. Requested resources: p4d=4, p5=8, g5=12, ENI limit=1500, EIPs=120, IPv6 prefix (/56). Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#012345678901

Jon: Good. Please add "LaunchDay: 2026-05-20" as priority note. Also add the expected cost delta for the committed capacity.

Mira: Added timeline and a short cost justification to the case (estimated incremental monthly spend ~ $48k for committed reserved capacity).

Samir: I'll open a Terraform PR to reserve subnets and pre-create TGW attachments. Quick snippet I'll include in PR: 
```hcl
resource "aws_subnet" "helio_private" {
  count = 3
  cidr_block = cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, 8, count.index)
  availability_zone = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[count.index]
}
```

Mira: Thx. Follow-ups: Samir -> network PR + TGW, Jon -> detailed cost breakdown, ops-sre -> fallback capacity plan (region fallback + smaller instances). I'll ping infra once AWS responds. :thumbsup:

ops-sre: Noted. I'll draft a fallback runbook in case quotas are delayed (limit to eu-west-10 or reserved burst in us-west-2).

Mira: Closing loop here — will post updates from the AWS case when we get the support reply.
